note: The Academy's pre-publication report, led by Christoph Reisinger, on how AI is changing research and practice across the mathematical sciences. It argues that the bottleneck is shifting from technical work to expert attention and judgement, notes pressures already visible (arXiv mathematics submissions up 75% in a year, journals suspending submissions), and sets out priorities on education and skills, independent verification, access to tools, research assessment, publication and mathematical knowledge infrastructure.
title: The mathematical sciences in an AI-enabled world
who: Academy for the Mathematical Sciences (UK); Christoph Reisinger (Oxford), Rachel Bearon, Thomas Bloom, Jennifer Gaskell, David Leslie, Zubin Siganporia
